posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-video-player 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。侧栏浮动窗口里的抖音式刷视频：本地/SMB NAS 文件夹上下滑动，或粘贴在线视频地址（yt-dlp 解析，支持 bilibili/YouTube 与 cookies.txt 登录态）；窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持全屏、拖动缩放、Range 流式播放，并提供 agent 视频推送队列端点。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d7e3f66fafcbfb74e734.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-video-player is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d7e3f66fafcbfb74e734.html
